lines.zh: 锅沿磕着地面，哐当哐当。
lines.en: The rim clangs against the ground, clank clank.
The pot is full, so I walk slowly.
Don't rush me, the pot is heavy.
Three legs are steadier than two.
I drag my base along the ground.
Each step rings like a night watch.
The water in my pot is sloshing out.
Who scattered bone meal on the road?
I hug the wall when walking at night.
The smell of rust follows me.
There's light ahead, I'll shuffle slower.
The lid is loose, I need to stop.
My base is cold, I don't want to move.
I crouch in the corner, don't look at me.
Steam seeps from my seams.
Quiet, the rust is growing.
Even a cauldron can stare into nothing.

lines.zh: 锅底的水凉了，我懒得动。
lines.en: The pot water cooled; I won't move.
Bone meal settles at my bottom.
No one comes to scoop me, that's fine.
A droplet hangs from my handle.
I count the bubbles inside me.
It's damp here, I rust fast.
Don't kick me, I'm resting.
Cold iron, cold heart.
I'll move again after dark.
Are you staring at what's in my pot?
Don't reach in, it's hot.

lines.zh: 我锅里的汤，还差你一味。
lines.en: My pot is one ingredient short — you.
Keep staring and I'll clamp onto your head.
Are you here to scoop soup?
I'm not cooking you in there.
Back off, my rim scrapes.
You stepped in my puddle.
Human, there's bone meal in my pot.
You want to lift my lid?
I remember those boots.
Don't shine that torch under me.
You're smiling, I don't like it.
The water in me shows your face.
Too close, the iron smell is strong.
I've been following you a while.
Thirsty? There's none in my pot.
Don't tap my rim, it rings.
Clang! A dent in my pot.
It hurts, even iron hurts.
Who hit me, my handle's bent.
Half my water splashed out.
Stop hitting, my rust is coming off.
A chip broke off my rim.
Even a cauldron yelps in pain.
That one will have me wobbling for ages.
My base keeps ringing from the blow.
Easy, I'm the one holding water.
Is that rust I smell? Let me get closer.
Whatever's in your hand, the pot wants it.
Stop waving it, I can't see.
My pot's empty and craving.
Let me sniff it, just sniff.
I want to touch anything made of iron.
You're bending down, is that for me?
My rim leans forward a little.
I shuffle two steps toward that smell.
Drop the meat and go; I won't chase.
Clang! My rim hit you.
Don't crowd me, the water will spill.
You knocked my handles ringing.
Make way, three legs don't turn well.
One bump is enough, don't linger.
My iron's thick, does it hurt?
My base is stuck on your boot.
Back up, rust rubs off on you.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我锅里的水晃了半天。
lines.en: You bumped me, my water sloshed for ages.
Go your way, don't hug my rim.
Pot against pot, that's how we know each other.
Easy, let the iron ring first.
Two cauldrons crouch side by side.
Your rim has a chip in it.
Our steam meets, that's enough.
Similar rust tones, not bad.
Don't clamp your lid on my head.
Come closer slowly, the iron will ring.
Two pots, one broth.
After this clink, we go our ways.
That piece of iron, I'm taking it.
Bone meal fell into my pot.
Rust flakes on the ground, mine.
My rim pinches up a small piece.
Who dropped this iron scrap? I'll keep it.
Picking things up takes slow scooping.
This much weight, my pot can bear.

lines.zh: 别抢，这块骨头我先咬住的。
lines.en: Don't snatch it - I bit this bone first.
Some bits settled at my bottom.
After this pile, I'll go.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的水洼了，铁锅要盖上。
lines.en: You stepped into my puddle; the iron pot will close.
Footsteps too close, my rim rises.
Something is tapping the ground.
That's not iron, that's living flesh.
Your shadow covers my pot.
Was that noise you?

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的家伙了。
lines.en: I see what's in your hand.
The water in me starts to shake.
Don't shuffle this way, I'm watching.

lines.zh: 你停脚，我锅里的水跟着晃。
lines.en: You stop, and the water in my cauldron sloshes.
Even a cauldron can lock a target.
I marked that turn of yours.

lines.zh: 这地方就你一个会喘气。
lines.en: You're the only one breathing here.
My lid loosened half an inch.
You hug the wall, so do I.
I smell sweat, it's you.
I follow, no rush to strike.
You take a step, my pot rings once.
My water sways with your steps.
You look back, I shrink into shadow.
The iron smell grows closer.

lines.zh: 别以为绕柱子能甩掉锅。
lines.en: Don't think a pillar loses a pot.

lines.zh: 锅在我身上，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: The pot rides on me as I creep closer.
My rim scrapes the ground, slow shuffle.
Your breathing quickened, I hear it.
Three more steps and it's close enough.
You raise a torch, I stay still.
My base presses grass, no sound.
You changed direction, so did I.
This corner, you'll pass it eventually.

lines.zh: 我数着你脚步溅起的水花。
lines.en: I count the splashes your steps kick up.
My puddle trail follows you.
Your hand shook, the pot saw it.
Waiting for the moment the lid flips.
My rim comes down, dodge!
Clang, right on your knee.
Iron against flesh, heavy enough?
I swing my whole pot.
Don't block, my base is harder.
This one comes with rust.
You step back, my pot follows.
My water splashes your face.
Hit, my handle still trembling.
Raising a pot tires more than a fist.
You guard your head, I hit your legs.
The flying lid counts as a hit too.
Iron on bone, what a crisp sound.
One more, my pot's not dented yet.
You slipped, perfect timing.
My rim scrapes past, leaving a red line.
Still holding water, here I am.
Clang, a cauldron lands.

lines.zh: 谁把我从架子上挪下来的？
lines.en: Who took me off the rack?
This place is damp, just right for me.
My lid's askew, let me fix it.
Bits have gathered at my base.
I smell a stranger.
Three legs planted, the pot steadies.
Just landed, my rust hasn't woken.
Dark is fine, a cauldron fears no dark.
Don't step on my rim, I just settled.
This corner is mine to crouch in.
Water seeps from my seams.
I rolled off the pot rack.

lines.zh: 锅底的水，煮着我的骨头。
lines.en: The water in my pot boils my bones.
A blade of grass hangs from my handle.
Who's breathing nearby?
The pot's settled, easy now.
Fire under my base, my water's near boiling.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，锅差点裂。
lines.en: Falling from a height, my pot nearly cracked.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，锅都快淹满了。
lines.en: I'm soaked, my pot's nearly flooded.
Boom, my pot got flipped over.
Something struck my pot wall.

lines.zh: 那股怪力穿过铁皮，直钻锅底。
lines.en: That strange force passed through my iron into my base.
My pot's empty, even my iron feels weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈在锅沿上，麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning struck my rim, half of me went numb.
The ground's gone, my pot falls into the dark.
